set deviceconfig system hostname edge-fw
set network interface ethernet ethernet1/1 layer3 ip 192.0.2.1/30
set rulebase security rules approved-rule from inside
set rulebase security rules approved-rule to outside
set rulebase security rules approved-rule source any
set rulebase security rules approved-rule destination any
set rulebase security rules approved-rule application ssl
set rulebase security rules approved-rule service service-https
set rulebase security rules approved-rule action allow
commit
